content.comment_body: Is it possible to combine multiple function block diagrams? When using 80 blocks, most of the workspace is already full, and reaching the maximum allowed blocks (400) seems difficult because the diagram becomes quite confusing.
If only your workspace is full, refer to the instructions in [product_name] documentation. You can enlarge the diagram area to make enough room for 400 blocks. Regard, [user_name]
There is a button in the menu bar of the diagram editor that allows you to add more sheets to your diagram.

analysis.insight_summary: Users encounter difficulty managing large and visually crowded function block diagrams as they approach the maximum block limit in the editor. The workspace becomes cluttered, making navigation and organization challenging. Users are actively looking for better ways to structure or partition diagrams to improve clarity.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect tools or features that will help them segment, expand, or organize function block diagrams more effectively as the complexity grows, to ensure better visibility and manageability.
